scientific_integrity: The article cited as 2026 motivation is not represented as proving this classification. Classical finite-alternating-group and sliding-block lemmas are acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Only the two-particle shift is classified; possible older equivalent treatment of a sparse countable shift remains a priority risk. No independent verification. The standalone checker covers finite samples, while full claims rely on the proof.
title: A non-residually-finite but locally virtually abelian automorphism group at quadratic symbolic complexity
